read_back_through: tests.helpers.pdf_pages.pdf_pages — the pages decoded out of the exported interior PDF, not the in-memory bitmaps
warning: This is evidence of what the book PDF looked like BEFORE CARD-145 restructured the export. It must NEVER be regenerated to make a test fail less: a digest that no longer matches means a page's ink changed, which is what G-1 forbids. If a later card deliberately changes a page's content, it records a NEW baseline in a commit of its own, with its own card number, and says so here.
font_fingerprint_note: The guide page and the SOLUTIONS divider are lettered in the system's Arial when Pillow can find it and in Pillow's built-in face when it cannot, so those two pages' pixels are machine-dependent. A machine whose fingerprint differs from this one cannot be compared against these digests.
